long_biography.plain_text:
Kois joined the leadership of the family dental-education enterprise established by his father, prosthodontist John C. Kois. By 2015, he had become chief executive of the Kois Center, assuming responsibility for its finances, staff, course schedule and daily operations. The Seattle institution delivers advanced continuing education in restorative, implant and aesthetic dentistry to practicing clinicians.

He also manages Kois Tribal Management, which administers the Kois Buyers Group for dentists who have attended the center. That role covers vendor relationships, memberships, finances and a digital platform designed to help independent practices access negotiated supply pricing. Kois is an administrator rather than the center's principal instructor or a practicing dentist, separating his operating contribution from the clinical reputation and original institution created by his father.
